alternative_hypothesis: H1: the same preregistered selector, without topology/provider-specific retuning, yields provider-convergent stationary and locally stable endpoints for a reproducible subset of topologies.
assumptions: E013 fixes carrier identity; E010 only reloads the exact source bytes and never chooses replacements.
The variational selector is a mathematical state-selection test, not a claim that physical Euler flow is dissipative.
The canonical constrained objective is Uc(q)=H(N[R(X+deltaX(q))]); every derivative, Armijo acceptance, Hessian and ringdown evaluation uses this same objective.
Reach normalization and deterministic resampling are part of the objective projection P=N∘R, not post-hoc operations outside the differentiated functional.
Topology preservation is monitored continuously by a nonlocal-clearance proxy and pairwise linking drift for links; this is not a full knot-polynomial proof.
Legacy A054/A057 scientific results are forbidden as evidence; only methods/equations are reimplemented.
A scientific FAIL is not issued when the registered numerical ladder cannot demonstrate objective descent or a converged Hessian sign; such cases are UNRESOLVED_NUMERICAL.

A stationary endpoint is not called stable unless its constrained-objective Hessian sign is consistent over eps, eps/2 and eps/4, the two finest Hessians converge within the frozen tolerance, and nonlinear reduced ringdown is bounded.
edge_cases: no constrained-objective descent demonstrated on the registered step ladder
Armijo descent exists but is blocked by topology-proxy constraints
Hessian sign changes across finite-difference scales
provider endpoints with similar energy but different geometry descriptors

falsification_criteria.criterion: After excluding numerically unresolved descent cases, the fixed constrained-objective selector cannot bring the preregistered carrier fraction to stationary topology-preserved endpoints.
Provider-distinct endpoints of the same topology remain outside the preregistered energy/geometry agreement bands.
For endpoints with a numerically converged constrained Hessian sign, stationary states have materially negative directions or unbounded nonlinear reduced ringdown.
Source-energy-sensitive topologies do not show preregistered provider-spread collapse after target-free state selection.
C++ FP64 fails the registered 1e-10 relative-L2 energy parity threshold.
The registered step ladder cannot demonstrate constrained-objective descent, or the constrained Hessian sign does not converge across eps, eps/2 and eps/4.

implementation_commitment.coverage_note: Commitment covers experiment/a054_state/native/configs/tests/requirements/cross_falsifier_contract; documentation and generated validation artifacts are excluded.
implementation_commitment.rule: Mismatch is an infrastructure/protocol failure before G0. Scientific FAIL gates otherwise continue diagnostically.

null_hypothesis: H0: provider-distinct current PKLSA/SKLSA representatives do not converge under the preregistered selector to a reproducible stationary and stable topology-level state beyond numerical/source variation.
objective: Re-run state selection from source-native bytes for exactly the E013 carriers using one canonical constrained objective Uc(q)=H(N[R(X+deltaX(q))]) for gradient, Armijo line search, Hessian and ringdown; quantify stationarity, topology preservation, provider-endpoint convergence and local stability; numerical inability to demonstrate descent or Hessian-sign convergence is UNRESOLVED rather than a scientific FAIL; freeze only provider-converged stable endpoints as a future A057 handoff.

observables.definition: Source and endpoint line-energy kernel for every E013 carrier.
Initial/final constrained-objective stationarity, Armijo/descent qualification and numerical-resolution status.
Minimum-clearance retention and linking drift over accepted selection steps.
Cross-provider endpoint energy CV, ropelength span and absolute-writhe span.
Constrained-objective Hessian eps/2/4 convergence/sign class and nonlinear ringdown amplitude/energy drift.

predictions: If provider dependence is mainly representative-state dependence, provider-sensitive source energies should collapse after the same constrained-objective selector.
If no topology-level equilibrium exists under the tested Hamiltonian, numerically resolved endpoints will remain nonstationary or provider-separated.
A stationary saddle must not be promoted to a stable particle-state candidate.
If projection-induced nonsmoothness prevents reliable descent or Hessian-sign convergence, the affected carrier must remain numerically unresolved rather than count against the physical hypothesis.
research_question: On one E013-frozen population of current E011 provider anchors, can a fixed target-free variational state-selection procedure map distinct source representatives of the same topology to a common stationary and locally stable finite-core state, without using legacy falsifier results?

steps.operation: Verify frozen protocol/implementation and exact E013/E011 source-byte binding.
Reload only E013-frozen carriers and recheck geometry hashes.
Validate rigid-energy invariance, exact constrained-objective evaluation, Armijo monotonicity and topology-proxy mechanics.
Run the fixed constrained-objective variational selector independently on every current carrier; classify failure to demonstrate numerical descent as UNRESOLVED_NUMERICAL.
Evaluate fixed-selector transfer on registered confirmation topologies.
Certify the common energy kernel against C++/OpenMP FP64.
Record optional GPU/DD32 framework screening without promotion.
Qualify stationary endpoints only after constrained-Hessian eps/2/4 convergence and then nonlinear ringdown on the same U_c.
Test whether initially provider-sensitive energy kernels collapse after selection.
Audit clearance/linking topology proxies over all paths.
Freeze only provider-converged stable endpoints as a future A057 handoff.
Assign the blind overall state-selection classification under diagnostic continuation.
Reserve framework reveal integrity gate; v0.5.1 contains no mass target reveal.
